complaint.description: On November 1, 2021, in Tallinn, an incident occurred. Myself and two other people were forcibly removed from a supermarket for refusing to wear masks. This refusal was due to personal reasons making mask-wearing impossible. After we left the supermarket premises, the security guard followed me and used pepper spray, hitting me directly in the eyes. Complaints to the police yielded no results. Moreover, I was accused of causing the incident.
